subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between T and Q when counted from the left of Q. U sits third to the left of S. P sits to the immediate right of S. P sits second to the left of T. V is an immediate neighbour of U. How many people sit between Q and R when counted from the left of R?
solution:
**Given: **P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only two people sit between T and Q when counted from the left of Q. 

2) P sits second to the left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e32f50eb9a0c5ed554b573cf8ad171610109bb68c267398a2320e9bc68db115.png] 

3) P sits to the immediate right of S.</p
